# GetPhysicsContactEntityA <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetPhysicsContactEntityA:Int32 index:Int32, world:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | The contact, from 0 to the count minus 1. |
| `world` | In | Int32 | `0` | The physics world, 0 (default) for the default world. |

**Returns:** The value.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Gives the entity of the first body of the contact, for one of the contacts of the last `PhysicsUpdate` (see `GetPhysicsContactCount`). Points and directions are in the world.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
